{{Quote|One of our Generals has gone missing. I tracked him to Takodana, but he isn't answering his comms. I need you to find Han Solo.|Senator [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], to [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]]|<ref name="BF II" />}}
A '''skirmish''' broke out on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]] between [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military|forces]] and [[General]] [[Han Solo]] of the [[New Republic]] as the [[smuggler]], with the help of defector [[Ralsius Paldora]], attempted to find [[data cube]]s stored in a [[forest]] that contained information crucial to both the Republic and to help [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberate]] the [[Wookiee]] [[homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk]]. Imperial forces interdicted the general, however, the timely arrival of [[Inferno Squad (Resistance)|Inferno Squad]] allowed Han to escape with the intelligence.<ref name="BF II" />

==Prelude==
Han Solo was on planet to find Paldora, an Imperial statistician who had two valuable data chips. One was a list of fleet movements, resupply points, and hidden armaments and the other something to help Solo liberate Kashyyyk. After discussing with patrons in [[Takodana Castle]], Han was able to find out he was a bearded man on the top floor drinking [[Merenzane Gold]]. After finding Paldora, Han snuck him into the forest to find the data cubes. The Empire was terrified that the Republic would find out how awful of a state it was in and sent several [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttles]] to make sure this information did not leak.<ref name="BF II" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|I take it back Chewie! This is the worst day imaginable.|Han Solo|<ref name="BF II" />}}
Han and Paldora first found the Imperial fleet logistics card guarded by several stormtroopers. Next they went farther into the forest to the shrine to find the Kashyyyk disk. After locating both disk, the pair went up to the Falcon and launched. While trying to escape the Empire sent a [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] escorted by a squadron of TIEs. The Imperials were later defeated with the help of [[Inferno Squad (Resistance)|Inferno Squad]].<ref name="BF II" />

==Aftermath==
Han Solo talked with Senator Leia via Hologram reminding her she couldn't get rid of him that early. Inferno squad would then discuss their plans for [[Sullust]] and [[Bespin]].<ref name="BF II" />
